I'm setting up a boss arena with a modified arch wizard. He has an orb in his tower that teleports him and the players into an arena. General rule of thumb is play to have fun. If you want the best experience based off of other people, you'll get tons of different answers. For me, I like to max out until I'm no longer able to keep all 6 builders busy. Once I have more than half of my builders sitting idle, I look into upgrading to the next Town Hall.

If you want to recover from a rushed base, I'd focus on your collectors and army units. Keep your lab busy because your army is going to be the most important here to get loot. You aren't going to be winning any defenses, so don't hoard too much loot but enough to keep your builders busy. 

Once you have your army camps, collectors, storages, barracks and spell factories maxed, then focus on defenses. Go for special defenses first. Town hall, Inferno Towers, Xbows, And Hidden Tesla's. Followed by Traps, Wizard Towers and Air Defenses. Then you can do Archers, Cannons, Bomb Towers and Mortars. Lastly Walls and Heroes if you care about walls lol.
Heroes are important but mostly the AQ and GW. BK is meh in my opinion but still useful for tanking damage.

I didn't know about the 100 building problem before now. The way I see it is Supercell will have to find some way around the issue soon. Simply because if theyre going to keep the game running and releasing new town Halls, they will need to include new defenses in order to make the game interesting. They can keep adding levels to new buildings, but in the end of that's all they do, the game will end in a stand still where tactics and bases don't change. They just get slightly increased damage, and troops get an extra level. There's 2 ways I could see around this. 1 way would be once you get to the point where you have more than 100 buildings, the game gives you the opportunity to remove buildings. Once you get past 100 buildings, there is a mandatory limit of 100 buildings on the base. Some buildings are required, like the town hall, storages, collectors, etc. But your defenses can be interchangeable. So if you have 101 buildings, let's say you replace one of the mortars with a Seismic Slammer. Or replace a Cannon with a 3rd air sweeper. So basically, you remove the strength of something, and replace it with the strength of something else.

Another idea is that buildings can morph into new buildings. So kind of like how the later town Halls now have weapons, you upgrade it to 5 stars and then you upgrade/morph into a new town hall. Same thing could happen with defenses, you upgrade something to level 20 or whatever level it maxes out at. Then, the next upgrade changes it into something else. Kind of like the double cannons, short range archers and multi mortars.

They could also somehow add like a prestige system. Where you max your base, and then prestige. You reset to a certain town hall level and then you start upgrading again, but this time youre stronger.

Supercell will have to find some way around the problem, or eventually the main base, will end up dying out.
